title: Understanding Model Bias
text: Model bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. High bias can cause the model to miss relevant relations between features and target outputs. Consider how different models might capture these relationships.

title: Exploring Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the loss function. However, it can sometimes increase bias. Think about how you might adjust the model complexity to address this.

hintAnswer: Use a decision tree with the same features.
